vo_open.text: This shrimp hunts with a bubble.

vo.text: It snaps its giant claw so fast, it fires a bubble at ninety kilometers per hour.
When the bubble collapses: two hundred eighteen decibels. Enough to stun fish.
It even flashes light. That glow would take over five thousand kelvin. Close to the Sun's surface.
vo.cap: Over *5,000 K.* The Sun's surface: *5,772 K.*

vo.text: Whole colonies snapping together can jam sonar.
It lives with a goby. The fish keeps watch, the shrimp keeps a feeler on it.
And one species was named after Pink Floyd, for its pink claw.
Who wins: pistol shrimp, or mantis shrimp? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.
